text: Ichihime said a male stranger often asked Miki Nikaidou out recently. He seemed to be a professor of the National University of Fuuchi. I was slightly bothered and decided to check things out in person.
I came to Tenhoukaku but she was not around. Where could she be at this time?
She's probably at Mahjong Soul Shrine
I heard she often went out with that guy recently
Go to National University of Fuuchi
Other than Tenhoukaku, Miki Nikaidou visited Mahjong Soul Shrine the most often. I should look for her over there.
But she wasn't there when I arrived at Mahjong Soul Shrine. Only Wanjirou was cleaning the yard on his own.
Wanjiro
Cleaning is really not my thing... A yard is not complete without weeds and leaves to begin with. How annoying...
player
Wanjiro, did Miki Nikaidou ever come to Mahjong Soul Shrine today?
Oho, it's you, {var:player_nickname}. Nice timing.
Wanjiro handed over the broom as he spoke.
I promised others to play Mahjong later, so I will leave the cleaning of the yard to you. Remember to do it properly. Otherwise, when Ichihime comes back, she will be mad.
But I came here for Miki Nikaidou.
Oh, that woman comes every day. It's about time... She will probably arrive when you finish cleaning, don't worry.
Wanjiro swiftly trotted away, leaving me behind to face the large yard. I had no choice but to help him clean it.
I waited until the sunset, but Miki Nikaidou never appeared. Where did she go?
According to Ichihime, Miki Nikaidou often went out with that guy recently.//nGoing out... Was that like, dating? Should I try my luck at busy places like shopping malls?

Thinking about it, I walked to the shopping mall. It was a holiday so everywhere was very busy. A sales event was going on and there seemed to be an advertising banner with Kana Fujita as the brand ambassador in front... Wait, no. It wasn't a banner. It was Kana Fujita herself!
I walked up and patted her on the shoulder.
Kana Fujita
She seemed to realize it was a public shopping mall and immediately covered her mouth while pulling me aside.
How did you recognize Kana? I was in disguise!
It's only a hat and sunglasses. Anyone who knows you enough can tell it's you... Do you really think this disguise will work? It's not like we are in a manga or novel.
Hmph! In the end, Kana's presence is just too strong. No matter how I disguise myself, my brilliance as an idol is unable to be shadowed.
Ok, Miss Idol. May I ask what you were looking at?
As I spoke, Kana Fujita suddenly pulled me to where she was standing and pointed to the front.
See, isn't that the flirty owner of Tenhoukaku? I never thought she could be dating a man. Are they a couple?
I looked in the direction she pointed. Not surprisingly, I saw Miki Nikaidou and a strange man with excellent manners not far away. However...
I never knew you idols could be so gossipy. I always thought it was the other way around - you were always the subject of the gossips.
Ha, being an idol sure has a lot of restrictions.
I'm really curious about what they are talking. Let's go eavesdrop, shall we?
I don't think that's the right thing to do...
You are quite close with her, aren't you? What if this man is a bad one? We are helping your friend here.
But how are we going to eavesdrop on them?
Let's have some coffee on the table next to theirs. Even if they find out, we can say something like "what a coincidence!". The coffee is on you though.
All those idol dramas she performed were not wasted. Only she could think of something so dramatic.
I am quite curious too. Agree with Kana Fujita's suggestion
Eavesdropping isn't good...
I wonder if Miki Nikaidou will meet him at his university. May as well try my luck.
Thinking about it, I walked to National University of Fuuchi, but it was a holiday so the university was quite empty.
Just when I was thinking if I should leave, someone said good afternoon to me. It was Hinata Takanashi.
Good afternoon.
Hinata Takanashi
Today is a holiday. {var:player_nickname}, why are you still in the uni?
I was just...walking around and happened to be here. Haha. Why did you come to the uni, Takanashi?
I came to take care of the plants in the gardening club. Even during holidays, they must be properly watered and nurtured.
You really like the plants, don't you?
Because I can feel the serenity and comfort of nature when I stay around them. {var:player_nickname}, would you like to feel it too?
Hmm?
Um, you said you were just walking around, right? So I was thinking... would you like to visit our gardening club as well? It will be fun.
I have a feeling that if I say no, Hinata Takanashi will be quite upset. I should probably go with her, and also enjoy the peaceful nature.
In the end, I didn't have time to look for Miki Nikaidou until sunset. I wonder how she spent the day...
I see. The coffee is on me then.
{var:player_nickname}, you are really nice, haha.
We sat on a table behind Miki Nikaidou and the man. They didn't see us because we were blocked by the restaurant's ornamental plants.
After listening to their conversation for a while...
What are they talking about? I seem to understand every word, but have no idea what they mean when all the words are put together.
I think I heard a few names of places.
But we have no evidence to prove that they are in a relationship.
But they are having coffee together.
Aren't we also having coffee here... Haha.
You are right... So it turned out to be our misunderstanding. So boring... Whatever, let's continue shopping.

You realized it, didn't you? My disguise was unable to shadow my idol charisma. That's why I must bring you along. My fans will never believe that Kana will go shopping with someone as ordinary as you, so even they see me, they will just think it's someone with a similar look.
With her irrefutably absurd reasoning, Kana Fujita pulled me away and continued shopping. I wanted to ask Miki Nikaidou in person but didn't have a chance.
Maybe next time.
Miki Nikaidou is a grown up woman and she has her freedom to make her own friends. As friends, we shouldn't care too much.
Well, since you say so, let's call it. {var:player_nickname}, you are such a nice person.
{var:player_nickname}?
I suddenly heard a familiar voice and turned around. Miki Nikaidou was standing behind me and Kana Fujita before we realized.
Miki Nikaidou
Are you two... dating?
No!
Before I could deny, Kana Fujita said it out. However, Miki Nikaidou was still giving me a suspicious look. She apparently didn't believe Kana.
I better explain everything and tell her it's a misunderstanding
She always mocks me. Why don't I do it to her this time?
Kana is right, we are not dating. We just happened to bump into each other here.
Well... Why did you hide here then?
We were watching...
Kana Fujita suddenly covered my mouth. I remembered that she didn't want others to know that she enjoyed gossips.
Watching... if Kana's fans had left or not. They seemed to have recognized her.
Oh? Is that so? Whatever, it's none of my concern who {var:player_nickname} hangs out with. Well, you two enjoy yourselves then.
Garghhhhh—What nonsense are you talking about?!
Kana Fujita pulled my ear in anger and growled.
Pfff—I was wondering how you two hooked up together. Now I can confirm that you really bumped into each other unexpectedly, am I right?
Eh? Why don't you believe me?
Ouch, should I walk away? Enough public display of affection here.
What did you say, Kana? I didn't catch it.
After Kana Fujita left, Miki Nikaidou and I were walking back to Tenhoukaku together. Should I ask her about that man?
If this really bothers me so much, I should make it clear
Better not. It's Miki Nikaidou's personal matter
I cannot explain this feeling of anxiety that I'm experiencing, so better ask her.
Nikaidou, today...
Hmm? What's up?
Were you dating with your boyfriend?
Hehe, are you concerned?
Yeah...
Why?
Why what...?
Why is {var:player_nickname} concerned that I'm dating another guy?
Because...
Tell Miki Nikaidou that she means a lot to you
Tell Miki Nikaidou that you care about her as a friend

The sky turned into bright red as the sun dipped below the horizon, putting a glowing silhouette around Miki Nikaidou. As I looked at her side profile, I suddenly felt that I should not intervene too much if she had chosen her own happiness.
The sunset looks so beautiful.
It sure does.
W-wait a sec...
I suddenly remembered how terrible her cooking skills were. The top priority right now should be to stop Miki Nikaidou from entering the kitchen... Could somebody help me? Anybody...
Because you mean a lot to me. I feel somewhat anxious when I think that you could be in a relationship with another man.
He is a professor of geology and I happen to have a lot of knowledge of gemstones. So he's been asking me for help on some topics.
I see... Glad to know that.
Nikaidou suddenly came close and put a candy in my mouth.
The sweetness of the candy in my mouth went all the way to my heart.//nThe sunset was stunningly beautiful, so was Miki Nikaidou.
As your friend, I am a bit concerned because I don't know this man well. I was slightly worried that he might have some ill intentions...
I see... Don't worry, he's not a bad guy. Well, a very reliable and gentle one instead.
That's good.
I had a feeling that Miki Nikaidou didn't really want to discuss her personal matters with me. We didn't talk anymore on the way back to Tenhoukaku. Did I just piss her off by overcaring?
National University of Fuuchi
Public shopping mall
Huh? Is dating so boring between couples? In one of the idol dramas I performed, the director asked us to act as passionate as possible and talk some intimate topics.
Eh? Have you already lost interest in their date? ...And why do I have to go with you?
Miki Nikaidou left after saying these words. She seemed to really misunderstand me and Kana Fujita's relationship. I should find a chance to explain to her.
Besides, she was always a rational and intelligent woman. I had confidence that she could handle the relationship well, so there was no point for me to ask anything.
Ah—
Idols are humans too. Gossiping is just too much fun to miss. Oops—you must not let my fans know anything you have just heard. Understand?
Yeah, we are dating!
Because I understand you too well. I can immediately tell if you lie in front of me!
Haha, nothing. I just suddenly realized I had some work to do at the studio. See you later, byebye!
Remember, if you lie to me, I will find out! But if you tell me what you think honestly, I can tell you our relationship. How does that sound? Fair, isn't it?
Ok, I'm in a very good mood. Let me prepare dinner tonight!
Well, I'm not in a relationship.
Here's your reward for being honest!
